title: Room Reservations Change Permissions Matrix
content:
The matrix gives, for each Room Reservations rate plan, which changes a confirmed reservation admits after booking and how changed nights are priced.

| Rate plan | Dates may change | Changed nights re-priced at the plan's price for the new nights | Room type may change | May be transferred to another guest profile before arrival | Nights can no longer be removed once the effective deadline has passed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | No | No | No | No | No |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Member Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Group Block Rate | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Reward Night Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Column meanings

- **Dates may change**: whether arrival or departure dates may be changed after booking.
- **Changed nights re-priced**: whether changed nights are re-priced at the plan's price for the new nights rather than keeping the original nightly rate.
- **Room type may change**: whether the room type may be changed after booking.
- **Transfer to another guest profile**: whether the reservation may be moved to another guest profile before arrival.
- **Nights can no longer be removed once the deadline has passed**: whether, once the effective cancellation deadline has passed, nights can no longer be removed and only a late cancellation of the whole reservation remains possible.

## Points of reading

- The Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate admits no change of any kind: no date change, no room-type change and no transfer.
- The Member Flexible Rate is the only plan that admits date and room-type changes but no transfer to another guest profile.
- The Group Block Rate is the only plan that admits date changes but keeps the original nightly rate for changed nights.
- On every plan other than the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, nights can no longer be removed once the effective cancellation deadline has passed.
